opening.argument: The video promotes an automated crypto-trading bot alongside a claimed return of $210 per day, while directing viewers to fund a wallet with Arbitrum ETH and stablecoins: “top off your wallet with Arbitrum ETH and stable coins, and you can run your own bot within 5 minutes.” It then instructs users to disclose an existing wallet credential—“you copy your 64 letter private key and paste it here then you click Save”—through a form visibly labeled Private Key with a Save button. The speaker’s own demonstration reports only $0.64 in one day and says performance depends on market volatility. Thus, the promised daily return, actual losses, and later outcomes are not established, but the combination of asset funding and sensitive credential disclosure supports the promoted trading-bot scheme.
